name: Clineignore
tagline: Block tool access to paths listed in a workspace .clineignore file
description: The plugin successor to the legacy extension's built-in `.clineignore` support. Reads a `.clineignore` file at the workspace root (standard `.gitignore` syntax, plus `!include <file>` directives) and registers a `beforeTool` hook that skips `read_files`, `editor`, and `apply_patch` calls targeting ignored paths, and `run_commands` calls where a file-reading command like `cat` or `grep` targets one. Also injects a system prompt rule so the model knows blocked paths are intentional. Edits to `.clineignore` take effect mid session. This is context hygiene, not a security boundary: unrecognized shell commands and `search_codebase` results can still surface ignored content.

install.notes: Create a `.clineignore` file at your workspace root using `.gitignore` syntax. Lines like `!include <file>` pull in additional pattern files.
